class.name: SDFObject3D
class.brief_description: Container and renderable 3D signed-distance-field object composed from child [SDFShape3D] nodes.
class.description: [SDFObject3D] is a Node3D-workflow container for SDF primitives. It compiles descendant [SDFShape3D] nodes into a single renderable SDF object and applies object-level operations, ordering and layer targeting. [b]Note:[/b] Runtime rendering is currently only supported in Forward+.

method.name: get_membership_layer_value
method.description: Returns whether the given [param layer_number] (1 to 32) is enabled in [member sdf_membership_layers].

method.name: set_membership_layer_value
method.description: Enables or disables a specific bit in [member sdf_membership_layers] for [param layer_number] (1 to 32).

method.name: get_affect_layer_value
method.description: Returns whether the given [param layer_number] (1 to 32) is enabled in [member sdf_affect_layers].

method.name: set_affect_layer_value
method.description: Enables or disables a specific bit in [member sdf_affect_layers] for [param layer_number] (1 to 32).

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Requests a rebuild of the compiled SDF data from descendant [SDFShape3D] nodes.

members.member: Material resource used by this SDF object. Its albedo tint is used as the default tint for descendant [SDFShape3D] nodes that do not define [member SDFShape3D.sdf_material_override].
